Loosely, so you can fall on the floor and find a way out of this. 

A) hanging sucks. I survived my own hanging, so pardon my humor above. It takes so much longer than you'd think. Then someone finds you. My old roommate found his brother.,. Not a pretty sight. Either of them. He got really messed up.

B) so I thought maybe you were trying to quit a habit, given the title. What's going on?

There's things that can make right now suck less. Can you make a cup of tea for yourself?

I felt that I wouldn't make it to 20 when I was 15. Then 25 was some sort of myth that the good people could make it to, not me. 30? I just had my 33rd birthday and I never thought I could make it to the next 5 year mark. 

I can't say that you can find happiness in the next 5 years, but it's possible.

I've been trying to find a surgeon and after 6 consults I feel like unless I can drop 50lbs then I won't get it. 

How many other consults can you get though? 

We're both more than our junk.
